transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 812 Pagehurst Drive?

Yes, this is 812 Pagehurst Drive.  
Everyone’s safe inside, no water in the house.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Four people are here. Everyone can come to the phone.

Thank you for letting us know everyone is reachable. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. No wheelchair or medical needs.
Understood, no one here can’t leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Everyone’s safe and can stay.
Good to hear everyone is safe and can stay. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats.
Understood, no truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 4 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right. Four people, no water inside.
Thank you for confirming your situation. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
